programElements.mission: Systems Modifications and Development The Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA) is engaged in several major Information Technology (IT) initiatives to improve and modernize the information technology environment. IT is the primary enabling capability the acquisition workforce relies upon to communicate with contractors, the Department of War (DOW) acquisition community and other customers. The National Defense Strategy (NDS) IT modernization efforts drive these initiatives. The DCMA continues to execute an IT modernization strategy established to improve visibility, insight, and collaboration between DCMA, the Military Departments (MILDEPs), other Defense Agencies and DOD Field Activities (DAFAs), other federal agencies, and contractors in the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). Core to this strategy is the Modernization and Analytics Initiative (MAI) program to modernize and integrate the entire DCMA portfolio of aging Contract Administration Services (CAS) capabilities and supporting infrastructure, leveraging Platform and Software as a Service (PaaS/SaaS) cloud environment, the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE), the Department of the Navy (DON) Product Data Reporting and Evaluation Program (PDREP), and Advancing Analytics (ADVANA) Business Intelligence and Data Analytics platform to enable departmentwide CAS capabilities. These efforts support the Director’s strategic objective to modernize CAS tools to improve DCMA processes, enhance DOW Acquisition insights, and standardize contract administration actions and data accessibility across the Department enterprise. Development and research initiatives are core components of the DCMA ability to align efforts appropriately to the DOW IT strategy. In FY 2027, the DCMA continues to invest in the PIEE (hosts Wide Area WorkfFlow (WAWF) and Electronic Data Access (EDA). This core initiative will empower mobile and fixed users' ability to utilize DOW enterprise capabilities at the same level with improved efficiency and effectiveness. The DCMA aligns with the DOW strategy for software modernization of enterprise capabilities. This involves migrating the DCMA application infrastructure to enterprise hosting environments and modern technology platforms, rationalizing existing applications to ensure capabilities align with mission requirements, and adopting new DOW strategies for modern software development methodologies. These solutions will improve process gaps to streamline/simplify automated contract administration, provide real-time data visibility, reduce manual intervention, and provide effective, regulatory-based tools for use across the Department. Blue List In support of DOW’s Drone Dominance, the Blue List is an ecosystem our US Government, and industry partners, providing an aggregated list of compliant Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) platforms and components. This will ensure delivery of secure, interoperable, and optimized solutions. To meet the needs of the DOW community, the DCMA is dedicated to developing and implementing its IT modernization strategy. The Blue List platform, designated as Defense Business System (DBS), is the definitive materiel solution. It will function as DOW's single, authoritative digital ecosystem for the entire life cycle of commercial UAS acquisition. It will directly enable the goals of DOW’s Drone Dominance by providing a trusted, vetted, and streamlined marketplace that empowers warfighters while ensuring enterprise-wide compliance and security.
